column3: In short, we're having trouble aquiring these pairs for breeding, and could use your help.
If you're able to contribute them to the Center, we're prepared to offer you a notable reward.
Would you be willing to do this?
Oh, that's wonderful! You are every bit as benevolent as I expected.
So, as I said, we'll need the Pokémon to be fully evolved.
Fomantis will evolve at a high enough level provided they get plenty of daylight, but Pansage only evolves through evolutionary stones.
Fortunately, we've already been able to procure those for this purpose.
Please take these.
\PN received 2 Leaf Stones!
You can use those on the final specimens for Simisage. Just make sure the genders are correct!
We'll be awaiting your good news, so please come talk to me any time you have a specimen, or would like to check what's still needed.
Oh? That's too bad.
We have no wish to disrespect your time, but should you ever change your mind, please come find us!
The Pokémon specimens we're still waiting on are...
Female Lurantis...
Male Lurantis...
Female Simisage...
Male Simisage...
...And that's about it!
Do you have any of these for us?
Any of them that you can get for us will be extraordinarily helpful!
Oh? It seems that you've already provided that specimen for us.
But if you do find one of the others, please bring it to us!
Oh, that's just what we'll need!
Thank you for fetching it for us; rest assured, we'll make sure it's healthy and happy!
...Oh! That's just about everything, isn't it?
Lovely! In that case we'll begin breeding right away!
You won't be likely to see them in the wild here any time in the immediate future, but rest assured, we'll get them ready for it in due process.
Thank you so much for your help~
As a reward, an associate of mine at the Grand Hall office should have something for you.
Until later!
The Restoration Project is going smoothly, all thanks to your efforts!
I hope the reward at the Grand Hall can be worth it!
Ah, I see...
So if you have both Shelmet and Karrablast in your party, you can use a Link Stone to evolve one of them directly...
Interesting how that works...
Ah, so it's important to maintain precise environmental control for this species...

Hm, this will be a unique challenge...
If only I could enter a password like "weathermod" which would allow me to select the weather from my PokéGear...
Alas, I'm sure it would disrupt regional weather currents far beyond Reborn.
Ah well.

Until then, you just let me know if you need anything.

Hello, Trainer.
If you're looking for my brother, I'm afraid he's not in right now.
...And I can only hope my son is with him and not off causing trouble again.
You! You're a Trainer, right?
Please, I'm begging you, do something!
My son has been kidnapped!
He was missing for a while, but I just assumed he was with my brother on vacation in Spinel Town.
Then just a bit ago, some bald-headed thugs came by and gave me a ransom note!
My brother is a famous musician-- have you heard of Master McKrezzy?
His album "Do Anorith Dream of Stonefleece Mareep" was a huge hit over in Kalos.
Now they've targeted my son to try and pick at my brother's success!
I don't know where they've taken him, but please! If you can, track down those bald thugs and save my little Eustace!
Thank goodness, my son came back.
He told me all about his schemes, and how you stopped him.
Rest assured, he is thoroughly grounded.
But I just don't understand why he keeps doing this...
Last time, he set fire to three apartment buildings in the Jasper Ward.
And before that, he got the remnants of the Magma Gang together and raided Dr. Connal's Orphanage!
And before that, he got the remnants of the Aqua Gang together and raided Dr. Connal's Orphanage!
Now the whole place is shut down because of him!
I just don't understand where we went wrong...
EUSTACE: This sucks.
I'm grounded and it's all your fault.
Why'd you have to go and play hero, huh?
Where were you when my Pokémon was stolen?
I should've never left it alone, but my stupid uncle was all "No, you gotta put stuff in the Day Care, it'll get really strong!"
Ugh! He DESERVES to have his money stolen for tricking me!
Let me go through with my plans next time, you got that?!
Say, you know how to make a bomb?
EUSTACE: I'll come up with a new scheme.
Something guaranteed to bring this city to its knees!
Just watch me!
In fact, who needs bombs? I can just use Pokémon!
Hey you, you know how you can make it up to me?
Give me an Electrode.
In fact, give me tons of Electrode!
Really high-leveled ones too!
At least level 160!
EUSTACE: No! That's not strong enough! Not explosive enough! I need more firepower!
EUSTACE: I said an Electrode, you Mankey-brained buffoon! Not--
This is my Vanillite, isn't it?
How did you...
EUSTACE: I guess people can do good things sometimes, too...?
I've... made a lot of mistakes, huh?
Okay.
I'll learn from this.
I'll try to be a person who does good things.
Like if I steal my uncle's money and donate it to charity, that counts, right?
EUSTACE: Ooh, what if I just blow up Citrine Mountain?
Then there'll be lots of room for new homes instead of crowding everyone into this city.
That's fine, right?
Oh, hi there. Don't mind me, Trainer.
Mx. Adrienn hired me on as a gardener for this little old place.
I've got a bit more work to do, but I'll be sure to clear out of the way before any battles fire up.
CORIN-ROUGE: Ah, my lady, to find me like this--
Truly, your wit is matched in brilliance only by your beauty.
It does me great pain to resist against an encounter so clearly willed by the fates as this one.
Nevertheless...
Though my heart may be torn asunder, I can never be with you!
It is a pitious end, to be sure.
And I pray that you will not be too crestfallen, my lady, when I tell you...
CORIN-ROUGE: Most impressive, my friend!
So you were able to find my companions, solve the riddle, and trace me all the way here...
You are a worthy adversary indeed.
However!
It is still not enough.
And why?
Well, that is because...
I, too, am not the real Corin-Rouge!
But now, I'll have to put an end to your plight!
You may have won the battle, but I'm afraid you've lost the war.
So, would you like to know where the real Corin- Rouge is? No tricks, this time!
After all, his plan has already succeeded!
Corin just needed to buy some time until his get-away was ready.
And now-- it's nearly the time!
The real Corin-Rouge is one of the three fools you fought before you found me!
But which one?
If you hurry, maybe you can still catch him.
Ahah, just kidding. There's no hope of that.
So long, my bewildered babe!
And now, I will take my leave.
May we meet again, never!
ADRIENN: \PN, you're here already!
That's okay, I just wasn't quite prepared.
To tell the truth, about my request...
I want to battle you.
It would be an official Gym Battle, of course.
Given recent circumstances, the actual status of the Reborn League might be unclear.
However, Victoria and I will handle the administration, and as for the Champion...
That's my second request.
I want you to become the new Champion.
That might have been your goal in the first place, but now I think it's especially important.
And I'd like it if it were you in particular, because from what I've heard, you've been the one who's done so much for Reborn's sake.
Of course, that still entails collecting all the Badges and defeating the Elite Four.
Probably no one would accept your new role otherwise.
And Lin--
Uh, actually, let's not go there.
Even if she defeated Ame, I personally will refuse to acknowledge her as the Champion.
But we need someone who can stand up to her.
You're our best hope for that.
You'll do it, right?
ADRIENN: Thank you.
ADRIENN: I know you might be scared, have other priorities, or think you can't do it.
But I think you're the only one who can.
Anyway, let's just take it one step at a time in the direction that's best. Okay?
To start, I would like to have our battle now.
However, I'm a bit swamped.
I've got a handful of workstations that are short- handed.
Not to mention planning the recovery party for Devon Corp. and what I've begun referring to as the Devonyx building.
It's going to take me a small bit to get those sorted, but I could use your help too.
That said, I won't force it on you.
Management is tedious work, and I would understand if you have better uses of your time.
Are you willing to help me out with a small errand before we battle?
ADRIENN: You are a genuine treasure, \PN.
This will be somewhat menial, but I would like to ask for your help with recruitment.
If you could explore the city and find anybody who might be willing to lend a hand to our work, I'd really appreciate it.
If we can get at least five people, that should be enough for me to work with.
Closer to ten would be ideal, and I'd make the difference worth your time, too.
Please have them come here if they wish to volunteer.
I'll handle the rest.
After that's settled, let's have our battle. Okay?

I'll be waiting!
ADRIENN: Even though it's menial, if you could go explore the city and look for anybody who might be willing to lend a hand, I'd really appreciate it.

I just finished assigning the last of our volunteers.  We've gotten so many, and it's all thanks to you!
I'm astounded! But then, exceeding expectations does seem to be your strong point.
Thank you so, so much for your help!
It must have been really challenging to go out and look for all of those people.
Here, please take these as a thank you from me.
Whenever you're ready, just take your place on the stand opposite to me.
And, \PN?

I wanna really enjoy this!
ADRIENN: Okay, \PN. Are you ready to give this another try?
ADRIENN: Okay, \PN! Are you ready for our long- awaited match?
ADRIENN: That's the spirit. Back up and at 'em!
You're not the Champion, so there's no shame or loss in having a few slips.
It's all part of the process, right?
Okay, let's try again!
Prove to me that my trust isn't misplaced!
ADRIENN: Yes! I've been looking forward to this ever since we met!
Okay, "Champion"! Picture this!
You're in your palace at the Hall of Champions!
A new Trainer, Adrienn, has just blown through all of the Elite Four.
Xe intends to challenge and claim your title!
Now you have to fight to defend your honor!
Although the roles are reversed right now, this is still a defining step on that adventure, so come at me with all of that same spirit!
Show me what Reborn's future Champion looks like!
ADRIENN: And there it is!
The Champion keeps their throne another day!
And of course, the challenger wins.
ADRIENN: There, you'll find two presents from me.
The first is your well-earned Amaranth Badge!
\PN received the Amaranth Badge!
ADRIENN: The Amaranth Badge promises that all Pokémon up to level 85 will listen to you faithfully.
Not bad for a Champion to have, I think.
The second present is the TM for Dazzling Gleam.
After all, you've got the whole world to show off to.
Why not be a bit flashy?
ADRIENN: And now, I think it's time to come back to reality.
There's still a lot that both of us need to do.
Victoria and I will take care of everything here in the city, but that means we're counting on you to take care of Team Meteor.
Just a little bit ago, I was notified that Grandview Station has reopened.
Although the tickets out of the region will probably sell pretty quickly, I've put in a special order with them for you.
If you go there, they can take you into the Tourmaline Desert. No charge to you, of course.
If what I've heard is right, then not only is your next Badge there, but one of the crystal keys as well.
It's best if you can get to all of those before Team Meteor does.
As I'm sure you know, there's a lot that I have to do too, so I'll take my leave now.
Please know that this challenge has been a pleasure,
And I will always be cheering for you.
ADRIENN: Oh. My apologies!
I don't mean to rush you.
No one seems to be picking up at the Grand Hall...
VICTORIA: \PN?
Okay, how do I steer this thing?
Can you hear me?
Ame used to give advice to challengers using these things, right?
But-- well, you know.
I'll try to see if I can help you, okay?
Though admittedly, after what we've just been through, this is a little strange.
I don't know too much about Adrienn's team or fighting style, but I have heard that xe fights in Doubles, so be ready for that!
And I heard a little bit about xyr Gym when some of the students from Apophyll were helping rebuild it.
Apparently, Adrienn designed it to switch tactics in the middle of a fight.
You can probably already see the Mist in there, but the atmosphere xe constructed aside from that is enough to power up xyr Pokémon regardless.
You might not want to count on just blowing it away.
But then, you might have to be ready for that happening anyway.
Timing and adaptability should be key, so really think about when you'll use your strongest Pokémon.
That's all I have for you. Good luck!
